title: Extract Java Class with Guice Field Injection

source.description: Absolute path to the source .java file to extract from (operates on its first top-level class).

target.description: Absolute path to the new target .java file to create.

module_name.description: Simple name of the extracted target class.

delegate_field.description: Name of the delegate field the source will hold to the new class. Emitted as `@Inject private <module_name> <delegate_field>;` (no constructor wiring).

item_names.description: Method names to move into the target class.

move_fields.description: Field names to move into the target class.

deep_analysis.description: Forwarded to extract_java_class. When true, runs deep dependency analysis (surfaces external_calls / inherited_dependencies / remaining-accessor reports and may return a Blocked plan that the macro propagates as a refusal).

callback_externals.description: Optional. Method names whose externals should be threaded as functional-interface callbacks. Omitted → extract_java_class default.

visibility.description: Optional moved-method visibility floor (package/protected/public/private). Omitted → extract_java_class's package/public floor logic.

target_prelude.description: Optional package/import prelude for the target file. Omitted → extract_java_class default.

rewrite_remaining_accessors.description: Optional. Forwarded to extract_java_class when set; omitted → its default.

source_delegate_wrappers.description: When true, generate thin wrapper methods on the source for moved public non-static methods so cross-file callers still compile.

propagate_class_annotations.description: Optional class-annotation propagation mode (e.g. auto). Omitted → extract_java_class default.

operations.label: guice_wiring_applied
operations.body: Extracted '${inputs.module_name}' with Guice field-injection wiring: the source delegate field '${inputs.delegate_field}' is annotated @Inject (no constructor wiring) and the generated target constructor is annotated @Inject. The DI container populates the delegate after construction. Verify the module bindings make '${inputs.module_name}' injectable.
